name: claude-music
description: Import streaming playlists (TIDAL, Deezer, YouTube Music, or exported files) or just name songs and albums, match them against your local library, fetch the missing tracks through your running Nicotine+ (Soulseek) client, and file every new track as it lands: tags, duplicates, Artist/Album/NN - Title.

music_dir.title: Music library
music_dir.description: Folder scanned for tracks you already have (default: ~/Music)

mb_contact.title: MusicBrainz contact
mb_contact.description: Email or URL sent in the User-Agent of MusicBrainz lookups, as their API terms ask

bridge_socket.title: Nicotine+ bridge socket
bridge_socket.description: Only needed if you set a custom socket path in the Nicotine+ MCP Bridge plugin settings

tidal_client_id.title: TIDAL client id
tidal_client_id.description: Client ID of your own app at developer.tidal.com (register the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43117/callback on it). Leave empty if you do not use TIDAL.

auto_tidy.title: Tidy new tracks automatically
auto_tidy.description: File each finished download as Artist/Album/NN - Title with normalised tags as soon as sync_downloads sees it (never deletes anything). Turn off if beets files your music.
